# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-28 from the 2026-10-28 Hub dump.

- 3,190,741 models tracked, 908,888 declare a base model, 941,891 parent links, 89,624 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
